payload.final_answer:
To find the match that satisfies all the given conditions, I will need to analyze historical match data from various tournaments. I will focus on matches where the winning team batted first and won by a margin of 20-30 runs, ensuring both teams batted all their overs. I will then check the opening partnerships, the number of boundaries hit by the top scorers, and identify the player of the match criteria. Additionally, I will verify the last over's performance and the dismissal of the opener by the player of the match. 

I will start by filtering matches based on the winning margin and then narrow down the results based on the other specific conditions.
